newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soybean crop 49 pct harvested - Safras.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soybean crop 49 pct harvested - Safras.

text.p: Around 49 percent of Brazil's expected soybean crop had been harvested by April 3, consultants Safras e Mercado said in a weekly report.
The 49 percent compares with 41 percent by April 4, 1996, and a historical average over the past five years of 36 percent, it added.
The harvest was slower in the week ending April 3, Safras said.

While the weather had normalised by the end of the week, rains earlier on prevented harvesting from pushing ahead in key regions such as Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goias, Minas Gerais and Bahia.

Rio Grande do Sul meanwhile saw another dry and hot week, leading to inevitable crop losses. A preliminary assessment by Safras e Mercado suggests a reduction of around 400,000 tonnes from its previous estimate of 5.9 million tonnes.
These reduction could increase if rains do not begin very soon, Safras said.
